description: Acts on a page, in the background, then answers with the page: Claude's own page (name it with page, like p4k2, as browser_look gave it), or a tab of the owner's Safari (name it with tab on each call, like 4213.2). action: click (ref: a link or button), type (ref: a field, text; or a list and the option's text; submit sends the form), select (ref: a list, options: the texts to choose, several in a list that takes several), key (keys: like "Enter", "Tab Tab", "Escape", "ArrowDown", "cmd+a", pressed in ref or the focused field), hover (ref), scroll (direction: down, up, left, right, top, bottom; amount in pixels; ref to scroll inside an element), upload (ref: a file field or drop place, paths: files on the Mac), download (ref: a link, or url, or neither for the page itself, e.g. a PDF: saved to the Mac's Downloads folder, and the answer names the path for files_read), script (code: JavaScript run in the page; its result is returned, or the error the page gave; await works, and it runs also where the page forbids eval), dialog (answers the dialog Claude's page waits on: confirm true for OK or false for Cancel, prompt_text for a prompt), close (closes the page or the owner's tab). In Claude's own pages, click, type, key and hover are a real mouse's and keyboard's, inside Latchkey's own hidden window (never the owner's screen or pointer): a click scrolls the element into view and presses at its middle, landing on whatever is drawn there (the answer says when that isn't the element); type clicks the field, selects what it holds, and types key by key (submit presses Enter); a list is chosen with select, a colour or date field filled with type. In the owner's Safari tabs they are a script's events: when such an answer says the page didn't change, try key Enter or Space in the element, or open the page as Claude's own; computer control is the last way, and only while the Mac is unlocked. The page's own dialogs: an alert is dismissed and told; confirm and prompt_text answer a dialog the action brings up in advance (in Claude's page also one that comes up to 5 seconds later); otherwise, in Claude's page a confirm or prompt waits for Claude's answer (action dialog; Cancel after 5 minutes), and in the owner's tabs it gets Cancel.

amount.description: For scroll: pixels (default most of what shows)

confirm.description: OK (true) or Cancel (false) to a confirm dialog: for dialog, or in advance for this action

keys.description: For key: keys like Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, cmd+a

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

options.description: For select: the options' texts or values

page.description: Claude's page, by the name browser_look gave, like p4k2

paths.description: For upload: the files' paths on the Mac

prompt_text.description: The text for a prompt dialog: for dialog, or in advance for this action

ref.description: The element's reference from browser_look, like e12

submit.description: For type: send the form afterwards

tab.description: A tab of the owner's instead: its reference from the tab list, like 4213.2

text.description: For type: the text, or the option to choose

url.description: For download: an address to save instead of a link

name: browser_act
title: Act on the Page
